newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firmer on dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firmer on dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar and weakened against the pound on Friday reflecting international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean bank rate of 20.4515 to the dollar from 20.504 on Thursday. On the pound, the rupee was posted at a mean rate of 33.414 from 33.324 on Thursday.
Foreign exchange dealers said the dollar weakened against European currencies in overnight international markets.
A dealer said the Bundesbank president's comments on German monetary policy could have contributed to the fall of dollar against European currencies, mostly against the pound and mark.
There was no big activity in the inter-bank forex market, another dealer said.
